findings: P1: plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping_catalog.go:208 | root cause: applyAndPersist restores the pre-apply Version after catalog.Save fails, while RotateMappingToken already committed Vault.Rotate against that Version and the next unique-key rotate CASes the restored Version | refs: plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:266, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:651, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping_catalog.go:199, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping_catalog_test.go:57 | impact: an authorized rotate whose persist fails leaves Vault on the new token; the dedicated page retry returns ErrTokenStale and cannot store another Token | minimal fix: after a committed Vault rotate, Verify the live version before CAS (or keep Version aligned with Vault) and lock persist-fail then retry rotate

P2[advisory]: plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:90 | root cause: persist-failure epoch retirement is only in-process, and CreateMapping maps a leftover same-epoch Enroll conflict on a new operation key to ErrReconcilePending | refs: plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping_catalog.go:211, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping.go:552, plugins/cloudflare-dns/mapping_catalog_test.go:57 | impact: after a failed create persist plus NewService/Activate, the UI mints a new OperationKey and that suffix cannot be created again | minimal fix: on Enroll-already-exists for an uncommitted new key, retire that epoch and retry the next identity; assert NewService after persist failure
result.summary: Local handle 已审完 1 页 range（b2969f..4d2b71，5 paths）、dependency subset 与 T-mapping-ui Recipe（R3，test=new）。已核对维度：Load fail-closed / dedicated not-found；unrestored Save 不再 Rotate；applyAndPersist 写入提交与回滚（create/share/rename/delete/rotate、Version-only、共享 secret_ref）；committed replay persist；同进程 vs 重启 vs 新 OperationKey 的 persist 失败恢复；NewService/activate 重载最后一次成功保存；UI vault 缺目录哨兵；新增 catalog 测试锁；授权/脱敏/确认/排除项未改。
